name: Alert Dialog
summary: Modal confirmation surface for consequential actions.
description: Modal confirmation surface for consequential actions. Use Tone=Destructive only when the primary action causes irreversible loss.

tone.default: Standard treatment with no semantic weight.

dos: Reference variables for every value; never hardcode a hex or px.
Change state through props, never by detaching the instance.
Return focus to the trigger on close.
donts: Do not put long scrolling forms in a small dialog.
whenToUse: Interrupt for a focused task, or a decision that blocks the flow.
whenNotToUse: Non-critical messages — use an inline alert or a toast.

keyboard: Tab cycles within the dialog only.
notes: aria-modal="true", labelled by its title via aria-labelledby.
Focus is trapped within while open.
